name: compass-rose
description: Compass Rose: a workbench and methodology that connects Codebase-Cartographer, ClauDHD, and Gantry into one idea-to-implementation pipeline for Claude Code.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: The connective layer over Codebase-Cartographer, ClauDHD, and Gantry: map-grounded design, a roadmap that is the hub, a two-lane triage, and a unified session brief. Declares the other three as dependencies, so installing it installs the whole workbench; orchestrates them rather than replacing them.

plugins.name: cartographer
plugins.description: Codebase Cartographer: documents a codebase (INDEX map, CLAUDE.md "Where things are" block, GLOSSARY, ROADMAP, CONVENTIONS). Also published standalone in the cartographer marketplace.

plugins.name: claudhd
plugins.description: ClauDHD: a NOW cursor that follows your branch, an idea inbox, a quick-fixes lane, a shipped log, and branch-aware session breadcrumbs. Also published standalone in the claudhd marketplace.

plugins.name: gantry
plugins.description: Gantry: a gated design -> plan -> build -> review pipeline with two living audit docs. Also published standalone in the gantry marketplace.
